## Install

**Easiest: paste this into Terminal** (Applications → Utilities → Terminal)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VictorKildahl/cra/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

It puts Cra in your Applications folder and opens it, with no security prompts. Run the same line again any time to update.

**Or download `Cra.dmg` below**

1. Open `Cra.dmg` and drag Cra to Applications.
2. Open Cra. macOS says it could not verify the app. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to "Cra was blocked".
4. Confirm with Touch ID or your password, then click **Open Anyway** once more.

You only do this once. Cra is an early, independent open-source project and is not notarized by Apple yet; every line of it is in this repository.
